title: Transcriptomic and Proteomic Profiling Reveal Immune and Metabolic Dysregulation in the Colonic Mucosa of People with HIV with Incomplete Immune Recovery
projectDescription:
Background: People living with HIV are called immunological non-responders (INR) when their CD4+ T cell count is not restored to immunocompetent levels, despite successful viral suppression. INR have increased risk of progression to AIDS, non-AIDS related morbidity, and death. Impaired mucosal barrier function is a prevailing hypothesis for why INR among people with HIV (PWH) have persistently low CD4+ T cell counts.

Objective: To understand the molecular mechanisms behind incomplete immune recovery in INR, we analysed gene regulation and protein expression in gut tissues from INR, immunological responders (IR), and healthy controls (HC).
sampleProcessingProtocol: Five biological replicates from each group were used for total proteome analysis of biopsies from sigmoideum colon and terminal ileum. Total protein was isolated from the snap-frozen pieces of the biopsies using Allprep DNA, RNA and protein kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s instructions with a few modifications. The samples were lysed in RLT buffer and homogenized using a QIAshredder (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The protein fraction was precipitated, washed in 70% EtOH, dried and stored at -80°C. The peptide concentration was measured in a NanoDrop OneC (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) at 205 nm, scopes method. Protein analyses were performed on a LC-MS/MS platform consisting of an EASY-nLC 1200 UHPLC system coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer operating in FullMS-ddMS2 mode (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA).
dataProcessingProtocol: Protein concentrations were quantified by processing MS data using MaxQuant (MQ) v.1.6.6.0.  The raw data was analysed mainly using an R DEP package (Differential Enrichment analysis of Proteomics data, Version 1.12.0). DEPs were identified using the protein-wise linear model (limma package inside DEP) combined with empirical Bayes statistics. DEPs were defined by adjusted p-value (alpha) < 0.05. Gene ontology (GO), KEGG pathway and Reactome enrichment analysis were performed using R package clusterProfile (3.18.1) and ReactomePA (1.34.0). The data was visualized using R packages including ggplot2 and VennDetail. The detailed method is included in supplementary data.
